content_sections.heading: About GKCIET Malda
content_sections.text: Ghani Khan Choudhury Institute of Engineering and Technology is an institute located at Malda. The notice states that the Medical Officer will serve the Institute's students and employees, including organising medical camps, blood donation camps and health awareness campaigns.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice does not name a department and does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Desirable: postgraduate medical qualification (MD/MS/DNB) in relevant specialities. The age limit is 50 years. The age is counted as on 09/12/2026, the date printed in the application form. For a Medical Officer retired from government service, the age limit is 65 years, and the remuneration will be pay minus pension. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

rows.qualification: MBBS with completion of one year of rotating internship and possession of a valid registration certificate from the Medical Council of India/State Medical Council
rows.experience: At least 2 years of working experience in a recognized hospital / dispensary

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Nature of engagement: purely on temporary and contract basis. Period: initially one year, which may be extended on yearly basis based on requirement. Consolidated remuneration, option a: ₹ 1,000 per hour subject to a maximum of ₹ 50,000, in addition ₹ 2,000 per month as conveyance charge. Consolidated remuneration, option b: ₹ 1,200 per hour subject to a maximum of ₹ 60,000, in addition ₹ 2,000 per month as conveyance charge. The notice does not say which option applies to which candidate. Visit: two hours between 03:00 PM and 05:00 PM, Monday to Saturday except holidays and Sundays. The Medical Officer should be available for consultation over phone in case of emergency. Accommodation: No. For a Medical Officer retired from government service, remuneration will be pay minus pension.

content_sections.heading: GKCIET Medical Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: To act as Authorized Medical Officer (AMO). To examine the patient and prescribe medicine/tests etc. To examine OPD/IPD bills and verify. To render advice on medical issues as required by the Institute. To organize medical camp / blood donation camp / wellbeing health and awareness campaign for students/ employees. Any other work assigned by the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GKCIET Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form for the post of Medical Officer in the format given with the notice (personal information, contact information, educational qualifications from 10th standard onwards, work experience, other relevant information, list of enclosures and declaration). Strike out whichever entry in the form is not applicable, and mention the category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-Servicemen) with supporting documents if applicable. Enclose the documents listed below, all self attested. Address the application to The Director, Ghani Khan Choudhury Institute of Engineering and Technology, Malda. Make sure the application is received by 09 December 2026. The notice does not state how the application is to be sent.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Biodata in the format Copy of the certificates of educational qualifications Copy of the MCI registration Proof of Date of Birth (Matriculation certificate)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications are liable to be rejected. All enclosures should be self attested. If any information is found concealed or incorrect, the candidature or appointment may be cancelled or terminated without any notice or compensation, as the declaration in the form states.

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer posts are there at GKCIET?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 vacancy for the post of Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the GKCIET Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application is 09 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GKCIET Medical Officer?
faq.answer: MBBS with one year of rotating internship and a valid registration certificate from the Medical Council of India/State Medical Council, with at least 2 years of working experience in a recognized hospital / dispensary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the GKCIET Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 50 years, counted as on 09/12/2026. For a Medical Officer retired from government service it is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration for the GKCIET Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Option a is ₹ 1,000 per hour up to a maximum of ₹ 50,000; option b is ₹ 1,200 per hour up to a maximum of ₹ 60,000. Both carry ₹ 2,000 per month as conveyance charge.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the GKCIET Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Submit the application in the notice's format, with the listed self-attested documents, to The Director, Ghani Khan Choudhury Institute of Engineering and Technology, Malda, so that it is received by 09 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is the GKCIET Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on temporary and contract basis, initially for one year, and may be extended on yearly basis based on requirement.

faq.question: Q8. What are the visiting hours of the Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Two hours between 03:00 PM and 05:00 PM, Monday to Saturday except holidays and Sundays, with availability for consultation over phone in case of emergency.

faq.question: Q9. Is accommodation provided to the GKCIET Medical Officer?
faq.answer: No. The notice states Accommodation: No.
